title: Binding Rules for a New HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
A new HomeGuard Homeowners Policy is bound only on a package (tier) whose entry gate the applicant meets. The rules below govern the application, the declarations set at binding and the start of the term.

## 1. Acceptance conditions

1.1 **Roof age.** The roof age at the effective date is at or below the tier's maximum roof age for new business. Roof age is the calendar year of the effective date less the roof install year.

1.2 **Dwelling age.** The dwelling age at the effective date is at or below the tier's maximum home age for new business. Dwelling age is the calendar year of the effective date less the year built.

1.3 **One homeowners policy per premises.** No other homeowners policy that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal covers the same property address. The check is made on the company's policy records for that property address; a cancelled or expired policy at the address does not stand in the way.

1.4 **Condominium units.** A homeowners policy is never bound on a condominium unit, which is insured on a CondoGuard policy instead.

1.5 **Renters policy at the same address.** Where the customer holds a live RentGuard renters policy at the same address, that renters policy must end no later than the homeowners effective date, because one residence is never insured under both at once.

The roof install year and the year built are facts about the premises supplied with the application; each age test is applied to the customer and the property address being bound, at that policy's effective date.

## 2. Declarations fixed at binding

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Coverage A (dwelling) | set within the tier's minimum and maximum Coverage A |
| Coverage C (personal property) | defaults to the tier's personal-property percentage of Coverage A, rounded up to the next 1000 USD |
| Coverage E (personal liability) | must be one of the tier's liability limit options |
| All-other-perils deductible | must be one of the tier's all-other-perils deductible options |
| Wind/hail deductible percentage | must be one of the tier's wind/hail percentage options |
| Water backup limit | starts at the tier's included water backup limit |
| Billing plan | must be one of the tier's allowed billing plans; the mortgagee escrow plan requires a mortgagee name and loan number on the application |
| Roof settlement basis | replacement cost when the roof age is at or below the tier's replacement-cost roof age limit, or when the roof material is one the tier lists as exempt from the schedule; the roof surfacing payment schedule otherwise |

## 3. Term and activation

- The term runs twelve calendar months from the effective date. On a new policy the original effective date equals the effective date.
- A bound policy moves to in force on its effective date; a policy bound with an effective date equal to the bound date is in force the same day.

## Hypothetical worked cases

*Hypothetical Coverage C default.* Coverage A of 318000 on a tier whose personal-property percentage is 70: 70 percent of 318000 is 222600, rounded up to the next 1000 gives Coverage C of 223000. On a tier at 50 percent the same Coverage A gives 159000, already a whole thousand, so it stays 159000.

*Hypothetical roof age and settlement basis.* Effective date in calendar year 2026, roof installed in 2014: roof age 12. On a tier whose replacement-cost roof age limit is 12 the roof settles at replacement cost (12 is at or below 12); on a tier whose limit is 10 it settles on the roof surfacing schedule unless the roof material is listed as exempt on that tier. The same roof passes a new-business maximum roof age of 20 (12 is at or below 20).

*Hypothetical boundary on dwelling age.* Maximum home age 80, effective date in 2026: a dwelling built in 1946 is aged 80 and is accepted; one built in 1945 is aged 81 and is not.

*Hypothetical renters overlap.* A customer's RentGuard policy at the address being purchased ends on 1 May; a HomeGuard effective date of 1 May meets rule 1.5, while an effective date of 30 April does not.
